title: Competitor Change Intelligence Monitor input
description: Monitor bounded, authorized public pages for material business changes. The safe default never mutates a trusted baseline.

targets.title: Authorized target pages
targets.description: One to 25 public HTTPS pages that intentionally expose public content, belong to you, or that you have permission to monitor. V1 checks one document per target and does not crawl recursively.

name.title: Target name
name.description: Unique human-readable target name used to organize reports and baseline identity.

url.title: Target URL
url.description: Absolute public HTTPS URL without URL credentials or a fragment.

changeTypes.title: Change types
changeTypes.description: Business changes to extract and classify for this target.

includeSelectors.title: Include CSS selectors
includeSelectors.description: Optional bounded CSS selectors whose matched content is eligible for monitoring. Selector safety is validated at runtime.

excludeSelectors.title: Exclude CSS selectors
excludeSelectors.description: Optional bounded CSS selectors for volatile or irrelevant content that should be removed before comparison.

ignoreTextPatterns.title: Ignored text patterns
ignoreTextPatterns.description: Optional literal or simple glob patterns for known volatile text. User-provided regular expressions are not accepted in v1.

currency.title: Currency hint
currency.description: Optional three-letter ISO 4217 currency hint. The Actor never performs currency conversion.

productIdentifiers.title: Known product identifiers
productIdentifiers.description: Optional identifiers that improve product-change confidence without enabling automatic product discovery.

sku.title: SKU
sku.description: Known seller or manufacturer stock-keeping unit.

gtin.title: GTIN
gtin.description: Known 8-14 digit Global Trade Item Number.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: Known size, color, or other product variant.

packQuantity.title: Pack quantity
packQuantity.description: Known pack count or unit quantity retained as source text.

authorizedRedirectOrigins.title: Authorized redirect origins
authorizedRedirectOrigins.description: Optional public HTTPS origins that are separately authorized as cross-origin redirect destinations. Every origin is independently safety-checked.

confirmAuthorizedUse.title: Confirm authorized use
confirmAuthorizedUse.description: Required for every non-demo target. Set true only when the public target belongs to you, intentionally exposes content for this use, or you have explicit permission to monitor it. This confirmation records existing authorization; it does not create permission.

baselineAction.title: Baseline action
baselineAction.description: The safe default compare_only never creates or changes a trusted baseline. Mutating actions require explicit selection and runtime lineage checks.

candidateId.title: Candidate ID
candidateId.description: Required only for exact candidate promotion. Obtain this value from a prior candidate report.

expectedCandidateHash.title: Expected candidate hash
expectedCandidateHash.description: Required only for promotion. Exact lowercase SHA-256 hash of the reviewed candidate snapshot.

expectedTrustedParentHash.title: Expected trusted parent hash
expectedTrustedParentHash.description: Required only for promotion. Exact lowercase SHA-256 trusted-parent hash, or NO_PARENT when the candidate was created without a trusted baseline.

includeUnchanged.title: Include full unchanged reports
includeUnchanged.description: When false, unchanged successful checks produce only the minimal auditable Dataset record needed for atomic pay-per-event charging.

minimumMateriality.title: Minimum materiality
minimumMateriality.description: Lowest deterministic severity retained as a material change in the concise report.

notificationMode.title: Notification mode
notificationMode.description: Optional post-persistence delivery. Weekly mode accumulates deduplicated redacted changes for the selected weekly window.

minimumAlertSeverity.title: Minimum alert severity
minimumAlertSeverity.description: Lowest change severity eligible for optional webhook delivery.

alertWebhookUrl.title: Secret alert webhook URL
alertWebhookUrl.description: Optional authorized public HTTPS webhook. Stored as secret input and never logged, persisted, or returned.

weeklyDigestDay.title: Weekly digest day
weeklyDigestDay.description: Delivery day from one (Monday) through seven (Sunday). Used only in weekly digest mode.

timezone.title: Digest timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used only to determine the weekly delivery window.

maxResponseBytes.title: Maximum response size
maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum accepted response body from 64 KiB to 5 MiB.

maxRetries.title: Maximum retries
maxRetries.description: Bounded retry count for transient network, 408, 429, and 5xx failures only.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Fetch and classify without baseline mutation, webhook delivery, or pay-per-event charging.
